question: Khubakeshei is a kind of song accompanied by clapping, sung in the state of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khubakeshei** is a traditional song genre from the state of **Manipur**.
 
• This type of song is unique in that it is accompanied by rhythmic clapping, adding a distinctive auditory element to the performance.
 
• Manipur has a rich cultural heritage, and Khubakeshei is an integral part of its musical traditions.
 
• The songs are typically performed during festivals and other cultural events, reflecting the vibrant cultural life of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipur** is one of the northeastern states of India, known for its diverse cultural expressions and artistic traditions.
 
• The state is home to various classical dance forms, including the famous **Manipuri dance**, which is one of the major classical dance forms of India.
 
• Manipur's music and dance forms are deeply rooted in its cultural and religious practices, often reflecting themes from **Hindu mythology and local folklore**.
 
• The state also celebrates numerous festivals such as **Yaoshang, Lai Haraoba, and Ningol Chakouba**, where traditional music and dance play a central role.
